title: The Final Will
author: Orsen Vane
blurb: Casper Okafor, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has spent seven years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
